text: Stop re-testing unchanged code before every job. Each job's baseline stage runs the full fmt, clippy and test suite on the base commit on Athena's machine before the writer starts: a mean of 20 minutes for each of the 30 jobs that landed from 1 to 4 Nov, about a third of a landed job's 60 minutes. The base's governed content was nearly always just tested: by the GitHub run of the candidate that landed, or by main's GitHub run. When a green GitHub result exists for the same governed content as the base (same fingerprint, the way candidate checks are already reused), reuse it as the baseline instead of running it locally; otherwise run it as today. Acceptance: a test where a green CI result for the base's governed content makes the baseline a reused record with no local run; a test where none exists and the baseline runs locally as before.
